summary: Risk sentiment is bearish today: Bitcoin and major altcoins fell as renewed Iran-related tanker attacks drove Brent crude above $100, strengthened the dollar, and pushed Treasury yields higher.[8][9] Equities and crypto are under pressure, while energy markets are strongly bullish; the available results do not verify same-day calls from most named analysts or provide reliable Forex Factory and Reddit signals.
